$comment: The docs site's ten sections, in the order a reader meets OrkStack. A page under site/content/ is written for the site and cites the repository docs it summarises: its See also links them on GitHub, and scripts/sync-docs.mjs checks that each link names a file and heading that exist. The generated references (orkctl, configuration, error reasons, API, changelog) are ported from the repository as they are. A group's featured routes are its three links on the docs home. A page's aliases are its old routes, which redirect to it. A hidden group's pages are built but left out of the sidebar.
